machine.name: Thermo-Compression Precision Die Attacher
machine.disclaimer:
SYNTHETIC PROTOTYPE TECHNICAL MANUAL

This document is artificially generated for the VectorAI demonstration and software development.

The specifications, thresholds, service-life values, maintenance intervals, and operating parameters are synthetic and must not be used for real industrial equipment operation or maintenance.
machine.description: High-speed, ultra-precision die bonding system designed to pick singulated semiconductor dies from diced wafer film frames and place them onto leadframes, organic substrates, or ceramic carriers with sub-micron positional accuracy using epoxy dispensing or eutectic bonding.
machine.manufacturingProcess: The die attach cycle begins with wafer expansion and bottom-up ejector pin actuation. A high-speed pick-and-place robotic bond head fitted with a vacuum collet lifts the die. An epoxy dispensing unit applies programmable dot or cross patterns onto the leadframe pad. The heated substrate indexer stage maintains precise temperature while the bond head applies controlled compression force to achieve uniform bond line thickness.
subsystems: Dual Optical Look-Up/Look-Down Vision Alignment Cameras
Collet Vacuum & Programmable Positive Purge Manifold

components.name: Pick-and-Place Bond Head Arm
components.function: Transfers dies from diced wafer carrier to leadframe with precise Z-axis touchdown force and X-Y-theta orientation.
components.importantParameters: Arm linear traverse vibration (mm/s), voice-coil current (A), positioning repeatability (µm).
components.degradationIndicators: Traverse vibration spikes (>0.7 mm/s), bond position drift, linear encoder jitter.

components.name: Vacuum Collet / Pickup Tool
components.function: Secures delicate silicon die surface via suction during high acceleration (up to 10G) transit.
components.importantParameters: Collet vacuum pressure (kPa), tip wear/contamination, positive blow-off purge time (ms).
components.degradationIndicators: Vacuum leakage (>-55 kPa), die dropping, collet rubber tip deformation, silicone residue.

components.name: Epoxy Dispense System
components.function: Applies micro-liter volumes of thermally or electrically conductive adhesive to target bond pads.
components.importantParameters: Dispense fluid pressure (bar), syringe temperature (°C), needle Z-gap (µm), dot volume repeatability.
components.degradationIndicators: Dispense pressure creep (>5.5 bar), epoxy tailing, dispensing void formation, needle partial clogging.

components.name: Heated Substrate Indexer Stage
components.function: Heats leadframe/substrate to facilitate adhesive curing or eutectic bonding while indexing strip carriers.
components.importantParameters: Heater block temperature (°C), temperature uniformity across heater zone (± 2°C), clamp pressure.
components.degradationIndicators: Heater block temperature drift (>195°C), heater cartridge resistance imbalance, leadframe warping.

components.name: Wafer Ejector Pin Assembly
components.function: Pushes up through dicing tape under target die to delaminate die backside from adhesive tape.
components.importantParameters: Ejector pin travel height (µm), ascent velocity (mm/s), pin tip radius of curvature.
components.degradationIndicators: Die cracking, tape piercing, ejector guide bushing play, pin tip deformation.

sensors.name: Arm Vibration
sensors.purpose: Measures linear motor traverse vibration on the pick-and-place robotic arm during transfer strokes.

sensors.name: Collet Vacuum Pressure
sensors.purpose: Measures negative vacuum pressure holding the silicon die securely on the pickup collet.

sensors.name: Heater Block Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures operating temperature of the substrate preheat and curing stage.

sensors.name: Placement Bond Force
sensors.purpose: Measures dynamic Z-axis compression force applied by bond head when pressing die into epoxy.

sensors.name: Epoxy Dispense Pressure
sensors.purpose: Monitors pneumatic fluid pressure driving the epoxy adhesive dispensing syringe and valve.

sensors.name: Placement Positional Offset
sensors.purpose: Measures post-placement X/Y spatial deviation relative to target pad centroid.

normal.description: Smooth linear motion with well-damped voice-coil servo loop.

warning.description: Linear guide rail dry friction or slight servo gain oscillation.

critical.description: Severe mechanical guide binding or loose bond head mounting assembly.

normal.description: Firm suction seal holding silicon die without slippage.

warning.description: Collet tip rubber wear, minor particulate leak, or tape residue on collet.

critical.description: Vacuum seal compromised; high probability of dropped die during transfer.

normal.description: Target curing and wetting temperature profile for silver epoxy.

warning.description: Thermal overshoot; risk of accelerated resin pre-curing on nozzle.

critical.description: Severe thermal runaway risking substrate oxidation and epoxy degradation.

normal.description: Optimal compression for uniform adhesive bond line thickness (BLT).

warning.description: Excessive force causing epoxy squeeze-out and potential die edge micro-cracking.

critical.description: Excessive compression force; high probability of silicon die fracture.

normal.description: Nominal fluid delivery through dispense needle.

warning.description: Epoxy viscosity increase due to pot-life expiration or partial needle clogging.

critical.description: Severe needle clogging or cured epoxy blockage in dispensing valve.

warning.description: Optical calibration drift or thermal expansion offset in staging.

critical.description: Gross misalignment risking bond pad shorts or wire bonding failure.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Epoxy syringe must be thawed at room temperature for 60 min before loading; syringe pot-life < 8 hours.
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 120 hours before required dispense calibration and collet replacement

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Inspect rubber/ceramic tip for wear, clean with alcohol swab, or install replacement collet.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Use collet microscope gauge to verify zero tip chipping. Perform vacuum pull test on calibration die.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Flush fluidics, purge expired epoxy, clean needle tip or replace with new calibrated gauge needle.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Purge 10 test dots onto calibration sheet. Measure dot diameter repeatability with vision system (target ± 5%).

maintenance.component: Bond Head Linear Guide & Voice Coil
maintenance.maintenanceAction: Clean linear rails, lubricate guide bearings with cleanroom synthetic grease, calibrate voice-coil response.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Perform automated friction compensation test in diagnostic menu. Verify smooth Z-travel.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Inspect pin sharpness under microscope, check pin height synchronization, replace bent pins.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Verify all 4 pins extend to identical height within 5 µm using optical depth sensor.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Check thermocouple contact resistance, verify thermal profile uniformity across all indexing zones.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Place multi-channel thermal logger on heater surface; verify temperature variance < ± 2°C across surface.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Vibration amplitude between 0.10 and 0.40 mm/s during rapid pick-and-place motions.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Vibration climbs into 0.40 - 0.70 mm/s due to linear guide bearing wear or servo damping loss.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Vibration exceeds 0.70 mm/s; mechanical resonance causes die position jitter during placement.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates mechanical raceway pitting on linear slides or loosened mechanical fasteners on bond head carriage.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Vacuum seal maintains deep negative pressure between -85 and -70 kPa.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Vacuum degrades into -70 to -55 kPa range as rubber tip hardens or collects silicone dust.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Vacuum drops worse than -55 kPa; suction insufficient to hold die during high-acceleration travel.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates elastomer tip fatigue, particulate clogging in collet vacuum channel, or solenoid valve seal degradation.

degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Temperature drifts to 180 - 195 °C due to thermocouple contact oxidation or solid-state relay aging.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Temperature exceeds 195 °C; high risk of epoxy premature skinning and substrate thermal stress.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Reflects heating element degradation, loose thermocouple sensor mounting, or PID loop tuning deviation.

degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Force creeps into 6.5 - 8.0 N range as voice coil calibration drifts.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Force exceeds 8.0 N; high risk of micro-fracturing delicate ultra-thin silicon dies.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates load cell amplifier drift, voice coil magnet thermal demagnetization, or mechanical guide binding.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Fluid delivery pressure steady at 3.5 - 4.5 bar.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Pressure climbs into 4.5 - 5.5 bar to push increasingly viscous epoxy.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Pressure exceeds 5.5 bar; fluidics nearing complete blockage.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Direct indicator of epoxy polymerization in the fluid line or partial dried resin clogging the dispense nozzle orifice.

rulModel.formulaDescription: Deterministic multi-parameter linear degradation model for Die Attacher. Weights sum to 1.00.

symptoms.symptom: Collet Vacuum Drop / Die Dropping During Transfer
possibleCauses: Pickup collet elastomer tip abrasion or tearing
Silicone/epoxy particulate accumulation inside collet vacuum lumen
Vacuum solenoid valve seat leakage
symptoms.recommendedAction: Replace pickup collet, clean vacuum filter line, verify holding vacuum reaches -80 kPa on calibration die.

symptoms.symptom: Epoxy Dispensing Volume Shortage / Dot Tail-Off
possibleCauses: Epoxy exceeding pot-life shelf time and undergoing room-temperature crosslinking
Partial curing of adhesive inside dispense needle cannula
Pneumatic pressure regulator valve diaphragm failure
symptoms.recommendedAction: Purge fluidics, replace dispense needle, thaw and install fresh epoxy syringe.

symptoms.symptom: Pick-and-Place Bond Head Linear Traverse Jitter
possibleCauses: Voice-coil linear motor magnetic track debris contamination
Linear guide rail dry friction due to grease degradation
Servo amplifier velocity feed-forward gain mistuning
symptoms.recommendedAction: Clean linear motor magnetic track, apply cleanroom grease to rails, re-run auto-tuning routine.

possibleCauses: Thermocouple probe mechanical contact separation from heater copper block
Solid-State Relay (SSR) short circuit failure in conductive mode
PID temperature controller loop saturation
symptoms.recommendedAction: Inspect and tighten thermocouple fastening screw, test SSR continuity, verify 160°C setpoint stability.

possibleCauses: Voice-coil touchdown impact force threshold set excessively high
Z-axis optical encoder scale missing counts during descent
Uneven epoxy thickness causing mechanical stress concentration
symptoms.recommendedAction: Perform Z-axis touchdown force calibration with load cell gauge (set to 5.0 N), inspect encoder scale.

failureScenarios.symptom: Collet Tip Wear Causing Die Release Failure
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: pressure_vacuum degrades to -58 kPa; cycle time spikes
possibleCauses: Rubber collet suction cup rim micro-tears
Positive air purge blow-off solenoid response delayed
Epoxy bleed adhesive contamination on collet perimeter
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace pickup collet with new PEEK/rubber tool. Clean collet holder seat. Calibrate blow-off purge pulse duration.
verificationSteps: Test pick-and-place cycle on 20 dummy dies

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: dispense_pressure rises from 3.8 to 5.4 bar; dot size decreases by 30%
possibleCauses: Conductive silver flakes settling and agglomerating at needle restriction
Syringe temperature elevated above 28°C
Epoxy pot-life exceeded 8 hours
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Unload syringe, replace needle with new 25G precision cannula, load fresh batch of epoxy.
verificationSteps: Perform 5 weight test dispenses on precision balance

failureScenarios.symptom: Bond Arm Voice Coil Vibration Resonance
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: vibration_arm climbs to 0.78 mm/s; placement_offset reaches 8.5 µm
possibleCauses: Bond head mounting screws loose due to repetitive high-G cycling
Linear optical encoder tape dirt smudge
Voice-coil flexible ribbon cable fatigue
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Torque all bond head mounting bolts to 1.2 Nm. Clean optical encoder scale with anhydrous ethanol.
verificationSteps: Verify arm vibration returns to < 0.35 mm/s

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: temperature_heater reads erratic swings (130°C to 210°C in seconds)
possibleCauses: Thermocouple clamp screw stripped
Thermocouple lead wire shield frayed
Heater cartridge internal resistance imbalance
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace thermocouple assembly, verify thermal paste application, verify stable reading at 165°C.

failureScenarios.symptom: Wafer Ejector Pin Misalignment and Silicon Chipping
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: placement_offset drifts; pressure_vacuum fluctuates during pick stroke
possibleCauses: Central ejector pin tip bent from tape puncture collision
Wafer expander ring tension relaxed
Ejector Z-axis motor zero-position lost
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace 4-pin ejector set. Re-teach wafer table ejector X-Y-Z coordinates with alignment fixture.
verificationSteps: Perform dry ejection test under camera inspection

failureScenarios.symptom: Die Tilt & Uneven Epoxy Bond Line Thickness
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: bond_force creeps to 7.6 N; placement_offset at 6.8 µm
possibleCauses: Collet shank angle misaligned relative to substrate plane
Heater stage clamping plate warped from thermal cycling
Asymmetrical epoxy dot dispense volume
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Perform optical planarity calibration on bond head. Inspect leadframe clamping insert flatness.
verificationSteps: Inspect bond line thickness on cross-section sample (target 25 ± 3 µm)

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Placement offset increases to 11.2 µm; camera lighting intensity alert
possibleCauses: Epoxy volatile solvent vapor condensing on bottom look-down camera lens
LED strobe illuminator brightness decay
Focal height shift due to thermal expansion
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean camera optical windows with lens fluid. Re-calibrate camera pixel-to-micron scaling factor.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Cycle time alert; vibration_arm at 0.55 mm/s; line jam interlock
possibleCauses: Leadframe strip bent or guide track width set too narrow
Indexer feed claw wear or mechanical backlash
Epoxy stringing onto indexing track guide
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clear leadframe jam, clean track rails with IPA, adjust track width with thickness shim.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: dispense_pressure creeping up; dot shape changing from round to oval
possibleCauses: Peltier cooling/heating jacket fan blocked
Syringe jacket RTD sensor loose
Ambient cleanroom draft disrupting thermal balance
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean cooling fan filters. Reseat RTD probe inside syringe thermal block.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: bond_force registers false baseline offset (+2.5 N at rest)
possibleCauses: Bond head load cell strain gauge pre-stress
Signal amplifier grounding loop noise
Cable flex strain on sensor lead wires
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Perform zero tare calibration in service utility. Check sensor cable strain relief.
verificationSteps: Verify 0.0 N reading with head unloaded

failureScenarios.symptom: Wafer Stage Vacuum Chuck Tape Slippage
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Ejector pin pickup failure rate increases; vision alignment offsets jump
possibleCauses: Wafer stage vacuum level decayed below -60 kPa
Porosity of stage ceramic disc blocked by adhesive residue
Tape frame clamping ring latch loose
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean ceramic wafer chuck with acetone wipe. Replace vacuum line seal.
verificationSteps: Verify wafer ring clamp lock tension
Verify -80 kPa vacuum under wafer frame

failureScenarios.symptom: Positive Blow-Off Air Pressure Regulator Leak
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: pressure_vacuum fails to recover quickly after blow-off pulse
possibleCauses: Blow-off solenoid valve plunger seal sticking
Pneumatic pressure regulator diaphragm pinhole
Debris in exhaust muffler
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace blow-off pneumatic solenoid valve. Clean manifold exhaust port.
verificationSteps: Measure vacuum release transition time (< 20 ms)

failureScenarios.symptom: Bond Arm Theta Rotation Motor Backlash
possibleCauses: Direct-drive theta motor bearing play
Theta rotary encoder disk contamination
Collet holder clamp set screw loose
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Inspect and tighten collet holder set screw. Execute theta homing and alignment calibration.
verificationSteps: Measure rotational alignment accuracy on glass calibration die (< 0.1 deg)
